# Joshua Vomberg — web designer, Cape Town

> Hand-coded websites for small businesses in Cape Town that take orders, bookings and payments. Built with Claude Code, live within about 7 days, from R6,500. Care plan R450 a month, included with every site from launch (first month free, cancel any time).

Joshua Vomberg is a 19-year-old web designer based in Sunningdale, Cape Town, South Africa. He builds fast, hand-coded websites (no WordPress) for cafés, salons, guesthouses, charter operators and other small businesses. Clients own their site and domain outright and can edit their own text and photos from a phone.

## Services and prices (ZAR)
- Starter website: from R6,500 — a clean site with contact and WhatsApp buttons, Google Business Profile setup, SEO-ready.
- Shop & booking website: from R12,000 — online ordering or bookings with card payment (Yoco, PayFast or Shopify).
- Care plan: R450 per month, included with every site from launch, first month free, cancel any time with a month's notice — domain renewal paid, updates and fixes, about an hour of changes a month, WhatsApp support.
- Changes without a care plan: R350 per hour.
